found: In the pages we read, we did not find these together in one tool.

items.name: Blender
items.does: shows the Python call behind a button and lists its operators; some tools are not operators
items.took: every button is one typed line, and the list of lines is read from the app's own actions

items.name: Blender and Bonsai
items.does: share operators between the screen and a script by design; no published test pins the two outputs together
items.took: a typed line calls the page's own functions, and a witness compares the answers

items.name: VS Code
items.does: keeps commands apart from key bindings
items.took: one list of commands; keys and typed lines are two ways to call it

items.name: AppleScript
items.does: describes an app's commands in a hand-written dictionary
items.took: our list of lines is generated from the app, not written by hand

items.name: MCP
items.does: labels each tool read-only or destructive
items.took: every line carries a class: read, trial or writes

items.name: BlenderMCP, MCP4IFC and the Revit connectors
items.does: ship a tool that runs any code
items.took: we leave that out: a line is a described verb, never code
